settings.heading: Every great player starts with great technique.
settings.subhead:
Ages 8–10 are the golden age of skill acquisition. Players who bank 15 minutes of daily ball mastery now build a technical foundation the others never catch up to.

The best academies in the world — Barcelona, Ajax, Manchester City — spend 80%+ of training at this age on individual technique, not formations. The TEKKY™ brings that method to your driveway.

The TEKKY™ helps every player build confidence, improve technique, and fall in love with the ball. Small habits. Big results.

settings.method_quote: By 14, a Spanish or Dutch academy player has tens of thousands of clean, deliberate touches. The TEKKY brings that European methodology home.
settings.method_cite: Founded by Philip Lund + Paul Hanson [dot] 40+ years coaching
settings.close_body: A 60-second quiz builds a 4-week plan matched to your player's age and level — plus the right kit to start.

settings.title: 10-15 minutes in the driveway
settings.body: Three times a week. No extra practices to drive to, no $300-a-month trainer. Just the right ball and a clear plan your player can run on their own.

settings.title: You'll see it in 4 weeks
settings.body: A good program shows week-to-week improvement with a purpose behind every session. Your player picks up a match ball after 4 weeks and it feels bigger, slower, easier.

settings.title: Quality, not just quantity
settings.body: It isn't only how many touches. It's first-touch direction, body shape, weight of pass, and playing cleanly with both feet. The smaller surface forces all of it.

settings.title: One ball, a lifetime of training
settings.body: Patent-pending, full FIFA-5 match weight. Buy it once and it grows with them from rec through high school and beyond.

settings.heading: Not sure where to start?
settings.body: Tell us your child's age and level and we'll point you to the right setup. Philip and Paul personally read every message.
